budget.bodyRetention: Exact decoded UTF8 source bodies embedded with original byte hashes; no source executed.
budget.requestedVsObserved: 6 permitted/6 actual GET; all200;0redirect/0retry;157948 body bytes;15s timeout each. Operations2–6 share monotonic60s guard; first tag request separately bounded15s, so no claim of a single enforced cross-process60s deadline.
budget.firstResponseRetention: Operation1 exact body reconstructed from retained tool output and byte SHA reverified; operations2–6 bodies retained directly as received.

actualObservations.interpretation: Only index6 passes structural roundtrip and token slices; all8 neural admissions blocked under unchanged global proof. code=null is not a passing roundtrip.

sourceFacts.claim: Metaspace Always prepends replacement only when a normalized split does not already start with it; split=true merges replacement with next. This applies per normalized split, not necessarily just once per request.
ByteFallback accumulates consecutive <0xHH> tokens and tries strict UTF8; invalid runs become replacement characters per byte. Single-byte token decoding can therefore fail despite a valid full run.

Python encode dispatches encode_char_offsets; Rust selects OffsetType::Char, while ordinary Rust encode selects Byte. The tokenizer bridge converts to original referential. This is intended API semantics, not proof of injectivity/disjointness or deployed binary equivalence.

Pinned tokenizer JSON declares Replace U+0020→U+2581, Metaspace always, BPE byte_fallback, decoder Replace U+2581→U+0020 then ByteFallback then Fuse; actual executable normalizer Replace/Fuse implementation was not fetched within budget.

hypotheses.claim: An artificial marker decoded as a leading space may explain roundtrip failure for inputs without a leading space. Receipt alone lacks decoded strings/token traces, so exact failing mismatch is not established.
Repeated emoji offsets may be multiple byte-fallback contributors for one scalar. This has not been established for actual token IDs/bytes in the saved receipt.

proofRequirements: Exact tokenizer/source/runtime and immutable original-text binding; source tag is not binary attestation.
Reject original literal U+2581 wherever normalization/decoder cannot distinguish it from U+0020; no guessed recovery.

Track artificial prefixes per actual added-token/normalized split; only proven inserted bytes have no original extent. Never trim arbitrary whitespace, subtract offsets globally, or discard an attended logit.
Prove original Unicode-scalar positions and independent cumulative UTF8/UTF16 boundary tables; exact scalar substrings, no normalization, no surrogate splitting.

Group only contiguous exact byte-fallback token contributors; inventory lookup, strict UTF8 bytes equal exact original substring, positive group extent and complete token accounting. No arbitrary overlap union or decode-and-search.

All contributors retain independent finite logits/unique-argmax/confidence >=0.4 including O; conservative group BIO/type consistency must be explicitly reviewed, no majority/repair/drop/minimum bypass.
Unknown/control, invalid bytes, unaccounted tokens, gaps, ambiguous prefix/split alignment, partial/overflow/lowconfidence/BIO errors remain blocked.

Adversarial mechanical witnesses for leading/multiple whitespace, CRLF/tab, NFD/astral/ZWJ/CJK, literal marker and byte/control-looking strings; preserve planned denominator and zero forwards until independently proven.
limitations: Fetched source is research evidence; package wheel-to-commit correspondence not independently proven.
Normalizer alignment/pretokenized conversion/added-vocabulary and Replace/Fuse implementations were not fully audited in six-operation budget.
No raw saved token/decoded strings in receipt; causal hypotheses cannot be confirmed from its booleans.
No model predictions or entity labels used; mechanical examples are not annotation gold.
